_comment: CloudFormation Parameters Template for Sample RDS Lambda S3Vector Integration
_instructions: 2. Replace the placeholder values with your actual AWS resource IDs
3. Use this file with: aws cloudformation create-stack --parameters file://parameters.json

Parameters._description: Full ARN of your Aurora PostgreSQL cluster (find in RDS Console > Databases > Configuration tab)
VPC ID where your Aurora cluster is deployed (find in RDS Console > Connectivity & security tab)
Comma-separated subnet IDs used by Aurora cluster (find in RDS Console > Subnet groups)
Comma-separated security group IDs for Aurora cluster (find in RDS Console > VPC security groups)
Prefix for naming AWS resources (1-20 chars, lowercase, numbers, hyphens only)
Lambda timeout in seconds (3-900). Use 10-30 for demonstration, 60+ for production
Lambda memory in MB (128-10240). Use 128-256 for demonstration, 512+ for production
